en: Black‑and‑white view over a small town taken from a terrace on a hill. In the foreground there is a gravel path, a metal bench, railing and flowering bushes. Below, a dense cluster of houses and larger buildings is visible among many trees, with a church‑like building and its tower standing out in the middle distance. Low wooded hills stretch across the horizon. White printed text in Swedish appears at the bottom edge, along with a photographer/publisher credit.
